name: Howard Gordon
bio: Howard Gordon is an American television writer and producer. He is well known for his work on the action series 24 alongside the thriller Homeland, which he co-developed with Alex Gansa and Gideon Raff, and for the political drama Tyrant, which he co-developed with Craig Wright. He also produced the science fiction thriller Awake.
place: Queens, New York City, New York, USA
